sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु तां कन्यां दोर्भ्यां गृह्य बलाद्बली ।विस्फुरन्तीं यथाकामं मैथुनायोपचक्रमे ।। ७.८०.१६ ॥
transliteration: evamuktvā tu tāṁ kanyāṁ dorbhyāṁ gṛhya balādbalī ।visphurantīṁ yathākāmaṁ maithunāyopacakrame ।। 7.80.16 ॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus, the powerful Daṇḍa seized the struggling maiden with his arms by force and proceeded to have sexual intercourse with her as he desired.
